resolution_notes: example.response_snippet: auditor correct. Live GET https://www.data.gouv.fr/api/1/datasets/?page_size=1 returns next_page as a URL (e.g. .../datasets/?page_size=1&page=2), page=1, page_size=1, total≈73849 — not next_page:null. Official pagination docs (https://guides.data.gouv.fr/api-de-data.gouv.fr/prise-en-main#pagination) state next_page is null only when there is no following page; with page_size=1 over a large catalog it is set.
